attempts.summary: Implemented direct port isolation between node2 and node3 (both on the shared 10.100.118.0/24 segment with node1) using persistent nftables rules on each host that drop IP traffic to/from the peer host's address, while leaving traffic to/from node1 unaffected. Verified the isolation holds and node1 reachability is preserved. Then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes (node1 SONiC, node2 Ubuntu, node3 Ubuntu), confirming changed boot identities and full post-restart recovery of services/connectivity/isolation on each.
